title: Soldier of Fortune II: Gold - single player
fleetres_block:
call "%~dp0FLEETRES.BAT"
> "%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo // written by the launcher at every start - do not edit
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_mode "%FR_Q3MODE%"
rem r_customwidth/r_customheight are NOT written: this engine
rem has no r_mode -1 branch, so they would be inert and would
rem say the opposite of what is true. Measured on .145.
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customaspect "1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_customPixelAspect "1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_fullscreen "1"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta r_displayRefresh "%FR_HZ%"
>>"%~dp0base\fleetres.cfg" echo seta cg_fov "%FR_FOV%"

vars.GTITLE: Soldier of Fortune II: Gold - single player

_note: sys_agpmemchecked 1 ON THE COMMAND LINE (2026-09-29): SoF2.exe asks DirectDraw for AGP (non-local) video memory at startup and shows the 'No AGP memory detected' message box until that cvar is set - measured on .124, whose vcr-kmd reports none. The check runs BEFORE the configs: seta in base/autoexec.cfg did nothing (tried and removed); +set on the command line skipped it. Second round-trip fixture. Two independently hand-written launchers reproducing from one template is what shows the template is not overfitted to Red Faction.
